title: The Table Set Before Opponents
english: To be more watery. The part of the humanization overflows. When someone 'beholds his glory, a glory as of the only-begotten from the Father' (John 1:14), the wine overflows. Therefore, he prepared this table not near the one being called, nor far from him, but before him and in front of those distressing him.

The apostle, turning this enigma to something clearer, writes: 'For a large and effective door has been opened to me, and many are standing against [me]' (1 Cor 16:9). When someone has a word and a door of a word strong and effective, he has many standing against him. And the devil himself stands against, wishing to prevent the benefit from the effectiveness of the word, as do sophist men and other evil men. Not so much, indeed, do they stand against, as having once attacked the one working well.

'In front of those distressing me' he prepared the table. He once said concerning that saying about the infant Jesus: 'For before knowing how to call father or mother, he will receive power over Damascus and the curs of Samaria in the presence of the king of the Assyrians' (Isa 7:6). It was not a great thing if the curs took [things] while the king of kings was absent, but in front of him, while he was present, they snatched what he had under himself. Or did he not plunder the magi in front of the king of the Assyrians? For they were in the act of practicing magic. They did not come to the child having previously repented, but while the demons were still active.

Such a thing, indeed, has been seen ecclesiastically, that those, having done their usual things in calling demons, not sparing them, recognized that the magic was dissolved from the child signified by the appeared star. Having come, therefore, to me, such a thing, these distressing ones were present, and in their very faces the things of the blessing happened. The 'in front of' can also be thus: they were present in opposition of will, wishing to prevent what is for them, or wishing to harm him. 'I anointed my head with oil' (Ps 23:5). You showed me Christ; according to what signifies...
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
